en: The image shows a colorized historical view of a European town square with old buildings featuring red-tiled roofs. A prominent statue of a man in a robe stands on a pedestal on the right. There is a shop with a sign 'Max Albrech.' and the background reveals a church tower with a distinctive dome and spire. The scene is calm, with a few people and a horse-drawn cart visible. The text 'Döbeln i. Sa., Kirchplatz.' is printed at the top, indicating the location.
